credit: つくよみちゃんコーパス（CV.夢前黎） https://tyc.rei-yumesaki.net/material/corpus/
source_version: dialogues-v2 + split-map-v2 (inherited unchanged from split-map-v1) + m3/v-real stereo (channel A = tsukuyomi-corpus-v1 train split, channel B = irodori-tts-600m-v3-voicedesign) + m3r/turns-B-backchannel (regenerated 2026-08-25 22:27-22:42) + m3r/roomtone
role: M3-R V-real. Same 80 corpus sentences and the same 72/8 split as v-real-v1, rebuilt with a five-turn shape: speaker B opens, speaker A answers in two parts, B drops a short backchannel inside A's answer, and B closes. Room tone replaces digital silence. This is the dataset M3-R trains on.

terms.training_use: Permitted: the corpus terms allow use for any purpose including commercial model training.
terms.redistribution: The corpus itself may not be redistributed, and this dataset embeds its audio, so neither may this.
terms.credit_on_publication: 本ソフトウェアの音声合成には、フリー素材キャラクター「つくよみちゃん」が無料公開している音声データを使用しています。

differs_from_v_real_v1: Five turns per dialogue instead of three (4.95 turns/dialogue measured; two dialogues keep three turns because their source sentence is too short to split). Speaker A speaks 1.975 turns per dialogue.
Speaker B backchannels inside speaker A's answer, so the two channels overlap: 1,204 simultaneous frames, and no dialogue is without overlap. v-real-v1 has 0.
Silence between turns is room tone lifted from the corpus recordings, not digital zero. In situ the room-tone floor holds 71-81 distinct values against digital silence's 18.
Tokenized WITH --no_whitespace_before_word. v-real-v1 was not, and 44.6%-46.6% of its emitted text tokens are a bare U+2581; this dataset measures 0.00% on both speakers.
One dialogue per training row (group_size=1). The four-dialogue concatenation used on 2026-08-25 was withdrawn; see the dataset audit section 2.
notes: The 72/8 split is split-map-v2.json, inherited byte-for-byte from split-map-v1.json, so v-real-v1 and v-real-v2 stay paired and comparable.

Only the corpus TRAIN split supplies dialogue speech. The 10 test sentences - the held-out evaluation set in data/experiments/tsukuyomi_ojousama/baseline-input/tsukuyomi-heldout - appear nowhere, checked both by artifact id and by transcript text (longest shared normalised run across all 80x10 pairs: 5 characters).

Room tone is the one place corpus audio outside the train split is touched: 16 of the 117 segments (1.83 s of 13.25 s) are noise-floor slices from 9 corpus DEV recordings. They carry no speech - selection requires RMS in [0.002, 0.01] and voicing below 0.5 - and the 10 test recordings are excluded by name in roomtone/index.json. Recorded here rather than left implicit, because registry/v-real-v1.json states that the corpus dev sentences never enter the dataset and that sentence no longer covers the room-tone pool.

Speaker B is the same frozen synthetic voice as in v-real-v1; the backchannel turns were regenerated on 2026-08-25 at 22:27-22:42 with the short two-mora wording, after tools/synthesize_turns.py:95-115 measured that demanding 1.1 s for two morae makes the TTS speak words that are not in the script (0/6).
Audio, tokenized npz and parquet are gitignored. The scripts, split map, manifest, tokenize sidecar and reports are committed.
Provenance of the build inputs: data/experiments/tsukuyomi_ojousama/m3r/v-real/provenance.json (244 files), verified with `python -m tools.provenance verify`.
The superseded stereo built on 2026-08-25 20:27 is kept, unmodified, at data/experiments/tsukuyomi_ojousama/m3r/v-real-stale-20260825/. It was never tokenized.
